method: source inspection only; nothing executed (lab files refuse non-canonical roots and pin D:\Git\lib-build)

findings.title: Absent or non-dict stored intake is reported as not changed by every layer
findings.fact: pass02 returns False when stored is not a dict; N5 returns None (no hold) for non-dict stored; N7 only checks dict stored, then delegates to pass02.
findings.inference: freshness() L980 then relies solely on revalidate(); revalidate is not in the packet, so whether it catches this is unknown.
findings.counterexample: Book with a current review in its journal; stored intake file removed or unreadable so read_stored_intake yields None; return bytes edited. source_changed -> False in all three layers.
findings.action: When a journal names a current review but the stored intake is absent or not a dict, return held/unknown instead of False.

findings.title: N7 pack region cut is a first-occurrence prefix match
findings.fact: bound ends at the first b'\n## Review' after the first b'\n## Return pointer'; prefix match also hits '## Reviewer', '## Reviews'. With equal bound hashes, the assignment row is dropped from comparison.
findings.inference: Any pack text after an early false cut becomes exempt like the Review section.
findings.counterexample: Pack body quotes an example block containing '\n## Return pointer' then '\n## Review - Codex Prime' before its real pointer; editing task text or the real pointer below the example leaves bound_sha256 unchanged and, if submission rows are unchanged, source_changed returns False.
findings.action: Cut only at the last exact heading line '## Return pointer' and the exact '## Review - ' heading that follows it (line-anchored, full-line match); otherwise treat the whole pack as bound.

findings.title: N7 book identity is a raw string compare; N5's stronger guard never applies to N7
findings.fact: N7 compares unresolved str(book) only; instance_id, resolved directory, link/relocation checks exist only for kind N5NN. exchange.book is resolved but is not compared.
findings.inference: Different spellings of one book over-hold (fail-safe); a different instance at the same textual path (re-clone or remapped drive) passes the book check and is judged only by row hashes.
findings.counterexample: Replace D:\Books\X with a fresh clone carrying the same pack/return bytes and a copied store; stored and live 'book' strings are equal, so N7 never marks it stale.
findings.action: Apply n5_instance_hold's instance_id + resolved-directory check to N7NN too (or compare exchange.book and instance_id in N7 source_changed).

findings.title: Nested composition depends on which p2 module copy each layer patched
where: n7 load_pass04 L56-58, BASE_CHANGED L69, patch L174
n5 load_pass05 L42-44, BASE_CHANGED L51, patch p2.source_changed L157
findings.fact: Each layer loads its predecessor with a fresh spec_from_file_location module, captures BASE_CHANGED at import, and assigns its own function to its own p2 copy.
findings.inference: If pass05 and pass04 hold separate p2 module objects (pass05 internals not in packet), a 'nest by captured predecessor' overlay can call raw pass02 from one layer and silently skip the other.
findings.counterexample: Composed entry imports the N5 layer, whose BASE_CHANGED is pass02 from the pass05 chain; an N7 book with a changed book string reaches pass02 row equality only and returns False.
findings.action: Compose by calling n5_instance_hold, the N7 check and pass02 source_changed explicitly by function identity in INTEGRATION.md order, not via captured module globals.

no_finding_checks: Review-only edit after an exact pointer: assignment row dropped only when bound hash is equal; return, manifest and artifact rows still compared (n7 L155-157).
Pointer or task-body edit with normal headings: bound hash changes, pass02 row compare applies (n7 L158).
Different pass on the same page: row paths include page/pass, so rows differ.
overflow: If '## Return pointer' is absent, regions() searches '## Review' from byte 0 (n7 L80); state would be pointer-pending/incomplete, so lower impact; not explored.
